## What And Why / 修改内容与原因

Describe the learner problem and the smallest behavior change that solves it.
说明学习者问题，以及解决它的最小行为变化。

## Verification / 验证

- [ ] Added a failing test before production behavior. / 生产代码前已添加失败测试。
- [ ] `uv run ruff check .`
- [ ] `uv run pytest`
- [ ] `uv build && uv run twine check dist/*`
- [ ] No dataset, weight, credential, or cache is tracked. / 未跟踪数据、权重、凭据或缓存。

## Learning And Documentation / 学习与文档

- [ ] Updated English and Simplified Chinese counterparts. / 已同步英文和简体中文文档。
- [ ] Kept heading structure and shell commands aligned. / 标题结构和 shell 命令保持一致。
- [ ] Linked examples to production code where relevant. / 相关示例已链接生产代码。

## Limitations / 限制

State untested platforms, data assumptions, measured tradeoffs, or follow-up
work. 说明未测试平台、数据假设、实测权衡或后续工作。
